transcript.question: What are we working on — existing codebase, something new, or still exploring?
transcript.text: GREENFIELD repo, but nested in existing work. Two existing repos for context: https://github.com/BMA-Corgea/GUTS (see proposals/guts_enterprise.md) and https://github.com/BMA-Corgea/GIMS-Project. Motivation: Evan failed a surprise SQL challenge in a job interview, which drove a push to harden GIMS into something enterprise-ready. Core flaw identified: GIMS currently pulls data OUT of a SQL database and transforms it with a templated Python script - too slow for heartbeat data. autoSQL's goal: automate data viewing, window creation, AND data transformation WITHIN SQL, behind an interactive UI where you pick what data and how to view/transform it while the tool generates the SQL underneath. Built as its own repo for granularity, then integrated back into GIMS. Not folded into GUTS because that project is too coarse-grained for this.

transcript.question: Which preset?
transcript.text: Chose preset solo-builder-review: human gates at spec approval AND QA acceptance; merge/deploy unattended. Rationale accepted - a SQL generator fails silently with subtly-wrong numbers, so eyes before ship.

transcript.question: GitHub access + what the proposal says
transcript.text: CORRECTION: GitHub access WORKS via git credential manager (helper=manager). gh CLI is NOT installed, and WebFetch is unauthenticated so it 404s on private repos - use git (ls-remote/clone) for BMA-Corgea repos. Read GUTS/proposals/guts_enterprise.md (1907 lines, 'the third arc'). Key facts for autoSQL: GIMS is the datastore/ledger organ - sole owner of INTENT (UserRequest/Proposal/ProposalItem) and HISTORY (LedgerRecord) per decision D12. It has a PgRecordStore Postgres adapter behind GIMS_RDS_ENABLED, a SqlRecordStore on SQLite, list_records_where + GIN index, pgvector for RAG (guts-code), and an append-only compliance trail with HMAC chaining. Heartbeats are classed as 'Firehose' volume (high rate, O(1)/record, GONS/GIMS only, never reaches GEDS); most heartbeat volume is byte-identical repeats, and the proposal's stated strategy is 'Collapse, never sample' plus 'backpressure widens the window; it never drops'. gims-ledger test suite floor ~711-965 tests.
